content: Project completed on 12 Nov, 3 days after the last planned due date. Analysis and early design were on schedule; most delays came in the last three weeks, from Cart & checkout through final delivery.
highlights: Every planned task was delivered and approved.
Design artifacts (class diagram, ERD, wireframes) were all on time.
risks: 7 of 18 tasks finished late; 4 of them in the final two weeks.
Late tasks chained: Cart & checkout slipped, which pushed integration tests, deployment and the final report.
